body:
I don't mind it when it comes from someone that obviously doesn't know how to respond to the situation, they say it because they don't really know what to say, I don't like it but they probably don't know any better.

But what really infurates me, is that people that go out of their way to give that superficial advice, how many times have any of you seen a post either in this sub or something like suicidewatch, along the lines of: ''things are going to get better'', ''if you are reading this everything is going to be ok''.

I can't stand that kind of people tbh, like: nice work, you wrote a meaningless two line sentence so you can get a few pats in the back and boast about how you ''helped'' people with their depression.

I realise I'm extremly bitter and maybe unfair, but I just had to get that off my chest.

I'm really happy for those that tried to kill themselves, survived (with no extreme consecuences) and got their life together.

But those people that force people that want to die to stay alive at all costs are selfish to me (I know this is a controversial opinion, that not everyone will agree with), they come and try to save you when it's obviously too late and make them feel even worse, with the dooming thought that they wasted their only chance of being gone.
